decisions.reason: The frozen files already contained the normalized envelope, attempt model, narrowed issue-05 ownership, and ready-for-agent status before this reused Reviewer invocation ran. Its assertions conflict with directly inspectable Candidate bytes, demonstrating stale conversational context rather than Candidate defects. A fresh Reviewer invocation is required.

All future implementation packets now remain non-claimable at needs-info while their blockers are active; the seed defines the terminal dependency rule and the first ready-for-agent transition after merge.

Issue 05 now defines the normalized attestation strengths and exact Host versus trusted-CI boundary. A custom cross-Host PKI, key rotation, revocation, and proof of model cognition are rejected as complexity that cannot honestly prove Host internals and is unnecessary for maintainer-governed merge authority.

The packets now define atomic attempt sequencing and state selection, canonical Candidate/invalidation ownership, fail-closed QA isolation, an exact risk floor and taxonomy, non-circular postmortem binding, an explicit gauntlet state machine, classified role manifests, and a parent-level schema ownership matrix.
